questions.stem: What is the function of the amniotic fluid during pregnancy?

options.text: It provides nutrients to the developing fetus
It connects the fetus to the placenta
It cushions and protects the fetus from physical damage
It removes waste products from the fetus

questions.explanation: The amniotic fluid surrounds the fetus and acts as a shock absorber, protecting it from physical knocks and jolts. It also helps maintain a stable temperature.
